# Morpheus same-version Winit termination patch

Baseline: complete published winit0.30.13 archive, SHA256 a6755fa58a9f8350bd1e472d4c3fcc25f824ec358933bba33306d0b63df5978d. All217 original regular archive members are preserved; the original published normalized manifest is additionally retained as Cargo.toml.upstream. Cargo.toml.orig, upstream Cargo.lock, LICENSE, tests, examples and build.rs remain exact. Four original Rust files change; termination.rs and this explanation are additive. The managed normalized manifest omits only six development dependency tables so Cargo can select this excluded dependency's library regressions without resolving an unused development graph. All normal/build dependency declarations, features/defaults, package/lib metadata and explicit target declarations remain unchanged; no package version changes.

The existing private WinitApplicationDelegate gains typed applicationShouldTerminate:. It is not replaced or swizzled. A pure Rust Weak application registration owns one separately created CFRunLoopTimer in default and actual NSModalPanelRunLoopMode. AppState owns the timer and the actual main-thread Rc Context. Native timer info owns only an Arc TimerInfo with an atomic pointer: native retain/release callbacks can run on any thread without accessing the Context or app payload. Main clears the pointer before any retirement callout; only the actual main-thread timer callback may take a local Context retain before calling app code. The application must retain its origin owner while Pending/Failed; mode-aware callbacks never replay a default-mode Winit/Slint event queue.

Startup/unregistered/missing/reentrant/backend/panic uncertainty refuses. Actual synchronous admission precedes Later, real owner observation precedes one BOOL reply, and caught Rust panic payloads are not printed or destructed across native callbacks. The only typed Now path is the separately reviewed ordinary-exit-already-successfully-posted race: re-observe actual Clean plus immediate delegate/backend/PanicInfo, with no cleanup replay or fabricated UI result.

This patch does not establish full native/app notification retirement, all Rust destructors or OS callbacks, real device behavior, actual Cmd-Q/Dock/logout/modal success, installation/update acceptance, signing, or distribution readiness. The coherent app main/lease/runtime/notification source cohort and independent unsafe/supply-chain review are required before any execution. Tests here exercise actual protocol state only and do not call AppKit.

Original license text is unchanged. This explanation is corresponding-source provenance, not invented license text or a legal/relink/native SDK acceptance claim. Root excludes this same-version dependency from workspace development feature resolution and retains all original development metadata in the two original manifest copies and upstream lock. The omitted development tools serve preserved upstream examples/integration targets; those targets are not selected or claimed verified by the four exact managed Mac library regressions. Actual Cmd-Q/Dock/modal/logout behavior remains a separate acceptance gate.
